prompt: Produce data/summary.json from the CSV files in data/ (per file: rows, columns, numeric min/max/mean).

events.input: {"command": "ls -la data/; for f in data/*.csv; do echo \"== $f\"; head -5 \"$f\"; wc -l \"$f\"; done", "description": "List and preview CSV files"}
